title: JSON export writes the issue date as the due date
body:
I exported our invoices with `python -m invoicing export --format json --output invoices.json` for the dunning run, and every invoice has `due_date` equal to its `issue_date`. Invoice 2026-0003, for example, was issued on 2026-03-20 and is due on 2026-04-19, but the export says `"due_date": "2026-03-20"`.

The due date in the export should be the invoice's due date.
